address: 18th floor, INNSiDE by Meliá, 43 Old Hall St, Liverpool,L3 9PP
bio: Experience a delicious Afternoon Tea with a view at Gino D'Acampo 360 Sky Bar. The iconic Liverpool venue offers panoramic views of the city alongside an indulgent Afternoon Tea.  Guests can enjoy the luxurious Afternoon Tea up on the 18th floor, either indoors or on the Sky Bar Terrace. The extraordinary views span across the city and beyond.  Their menu includes a variety of flavours striking a perfect balance of sweet and savoury treats, including a deli assortment and freshly baked scones.  Gino D'Acampo 360 Sky Bar is in Liverpool City Centre, just a short walk from Moorfields train station.
